Ranking only the supplied references by query_distance_db gives C04 (6.351741 dB), C03 (6.913446 dB), then C01 (9.488009 dB). The nearest, C04, exceeds its condition-specific 2.463183 dB threshold; the other two also exceed their thresholds.
